name: D
note: Attempt D: restart forced by a bug. Runs A-C started from a broken copy of the pilot: NEAT's tanh output squashed the cloned scores to ties, so 1 step in 9 took the wrong action (the copy landed 43% in wind instead of 92%). Fixed (identity outputs, test). Restarting, so three more changes ride along: the 15-input clone (+2 route sensors), seed noise 0.02 and weight mutation power 0.05 (the boulder skill is fragile: noise 0.05 cost ~10 points), and 30% boulder flights mixed into stages 1-4 so selection keeps protecting the boulder skill (forgotten twice before). The exact start network: 98% wind, 77% boulder (60 flights each).

stages.name: calm
stages.expect: Pass at once: the exact copy of the pilot lands nearly every calm flight.

stages.name: steady push
stages.expect: Lean into a constant push that grows from 5 to 15. The pilot lands ~84-90% here, so pass at 90%. Risk: landing off the pad downwind.

stages.name: gusts
stages.expect: Real gusts at full strength. The wind project's best NEAT reached ~91% with turbulence; aim 95% without.

stages.name: gusts + turbulence
stages.expect: Full wind. The start network already lands ~98% here (60 flights); keep it while turbulence ramps up.

stages.name: boulder
stages.expect: The start network already lands ~77% with full boulders. Ramp 60% -> 100% size; pass at 95% with no hits.

stages.name: polish
stages.expect: Everything on, only the env score + landing bonus. Pass = 98% on 100 + 100 fresh flights, then the 1,000-flight goal check.
